crossRefs.note: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning, won’t be blessed in the end.
He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.
He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.
He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.
For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.
Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.
Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.
As the partridge that sits on eggs which she has not laid, so is he who gets riches, and not by right. In the middle of…
Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases…
Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?
Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.
A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning, won’t be blessed in the end.
Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds:
For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

translations.web: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.
translations.bsb: Dishonest wealth will dwindle, but what is earned through hard work will be multiplied.
translations.kjv: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
translations.asv: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished; But he that gathereth by labor shall have increase.
